julia: heads-up — after landing the kv-prefetch flag for the packer, we see ~12-18% p99 regressions on small-chat workloads with AWQ int8 weight-only.
raj: repro steps?
julia: ran the staging suite with the exact command: `./perf/run_infer_bench --model=gptj-awq-int8 --seq=64 --batch=1 --kvcache=on --pack=true --prefetch=on`
perf-bot: perf alert: p99 latency +15% vs baseline; allocation spike in `pack_buffer`; see recent telemetry.
kai: quick hypothesis — prefetch increases overlap, but pack buffer copies are now on the hot path -> extra memcpy + unaligned loads.
tom: can you paste the `perf record` top stacks or a pprof flame? also check kernel-chooser logs for fallback churn.
julia: small flame snapshot from `perf top` (samplified):
```
# top stacks
pack_kernel_memcpy 45%
kv_lookup 20%
matmul_kernel_int8 18%
other 17%
```
marta: interesting. could be group-size interaction. if group_size=64 the packed buffer is bigger -> more L1/L2 thrash. try group_size=32.
raj: agreed — let's run a microbench across group sizes and prefetch toggle: `./microbench/pack_probe --group=32,48,64 --prefetch=on,off --batch=1 --seq=64`
julia: ran that matrix on the same hardware. short results (median of 100 runs):
`group=64 prefetch=on p99=84ms; group=64 prefetch=off p99=72ms; group=32 prefetch=on p99=69ms; baseline (no pack/prefetch) p99=65ms`
kai: that suggests pack overhead scales superlinearly with group size when prefetch touches more cache lines — prefetch on + large group creates spill into slower memory.
tom: short-term mitigation: disable kv-prefetch for the small-chat route and roll a canary to validate impact on p99. :thumbsup:
marta: longer-term, we should make packer prefetch double-buffered and avoid memcpy when data alignment is already good (zero-copy path). also consider lowering default group_size for latency-sensitive routes.
raj: can we also validate kernel chooser isn't switching to a slower int8 matmul variant because of transient bandwidth pressure? add logs around kernel selection (`KERNEL_CHOICE` trace) for the canary.
julia: will add chooser trace and start canary disabling prefetch for 5% of traffic. plan: 1) canary disable prefetch on small-chat route, 2) run controlled microbench matrix over group sizes and batch sizes, 3) prototype double-buffered prefetch + zero-copy opt, 4) add kernel-chooser traces for rollout.
perf-bot: created perf ticket P-3124, assigned `perf-oncall`. linked traces / bench artifacts.
raj: also schedule a bisect session tomorrow to narrow the commit that introduced the regression (suspect: packer prefetch landing + allocator tweak). pinging @perf-oncall and @runtime-sig.
julia: thanks — I'll post benchmark dumps and the canary results here once running.
marta: one more note — check quant calibration path: if calibration adds padding to groups, real group_size might differ from config. I've seen that inflate buffer sizes unexpectedly.
julia: good call, will validate calibration outputs as part of the microbench.
raj: ok, next steps captured. if canary confirms improvement we'll ship the prefetch-disable for latency tier and continue with the packer redesign.
julia: adding a short TODO list for follow-ups: `1) canary rollout, 2) microbench matrix + perf histograms, 3) allocator/align investigation, 4) double-buffer prototype, 5) kernel-chooser traces, 6) calibration-size audit`
perf-bot: noted. automated nightly run scheduled for the microbench matrix.
julia: thanks everyone — will update thread with numbers.
